description: The official skill rules the harness deliberately overrides, each with the verbatim quote of the rule. check-tools.ps1 reports whether every installed copy of each skill still contains its quote: a quote no copy contains means the official rule changed and the exception is stale. documentedIn is relative to the setup-project skill: tests/Test-Repository.ps1 fails when that file no longer quotes the same text.
maintenance: Changing an exception in skills/setup-project/templates/docs/agents/skill-exceptions.md means updating the matching entry here in the same commit.

exceptions.quote: Python is the language for automation **logic**
leaves one small test or an assert-based self-check
